description: This file defines the BIFF5 class that contains a color map for BIFF5 built-in colors and a method to lookup RGB values by color index.

classes.name: BIFF5
classes.description: Represents a color mapping for BIFF5 embedded in the PHPSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the RGB color associated with a given BIFF5 color index.
